criteria.resumableSetup: Guest goal fields, edited target review and final confirmation survive reload. Account setup survives reload and later sign-in after project/account ownership verification. Credentials excluded and unrelated/corrupt drafts ignored.
criteria.actionHierarchy: Set up my tracking labels the real next step. Onboarding target alternatives are collapsed; primary estimate/confirm and explicit deferral remain. Name/body data retained.
criteria.firstRealEntry: Web/native existing manual meal and movement forms save durable real records. Prompt survives reload/cancel, then clears after real tracking or explicit later. Examples and purchases do not qualify.
criteria.boundaries: Rejected deletion preserves records/draft; confirmed deletion removes only that account draft. Missing art retains usable tour and records. Rejected prompt-marker writes do not automatically retry on unrelated navigation.

limits: No human usability study or conversion/retention measurement
Existing bundle and native lint warnings

learning.disposition: Recorded as working implementation awaiting user acceptance
